title: 第1180章 前往仙界第1179章 送别少主
content_zh:
第1180章前往仙界
话音落下，空气瞬间一静。
袁良梅脸上的艳羡之色瞬间僵住，脸颊肌肉狠狠抽搐几下，整张脸瞬间绿得通透，难看至极。他一辈子好面子爱攀高枝，此刻被陆长风这般直白“惦记”，听着这番看似真诚、实则嘲讽的话语，只觉得浑身别扭，老脸挂不住了。
周遭一众官吏世家见状皆是强忍笑意，一个个憋得肩膀轻颤。都是一个圈里的人，谁都知道彼此想去仙界。现在陆长风这般问候，听着太像羞辱人了。可偏偏他语气真挚，一副真心道别的憨直模样，让袁良梅挑不出半分错处，只能硬生生咽下这口闷气。是吧，一个家奴都傍上少主了，你这老爷还原地踏步，真是够蠢的……
“诸位，再会！”
即便心有不甘，少主还是保持了风度，对众人微微拱手，就要离去。
可就在此时，一道浩荡威严的仙音骤然从天际云端落下，震彻整座云港。
“天帝法旨至！”
众人闻声纷纷抬头，只见云层破开一道缝隙，一名身着紫金黑袍，头戴仙冠的仙官踏云而来，身姿飘逸，气度森严，手中高托鎏金圣旨，步履沉稳落至高台正中。
天帝法旨，这是至高无上的存在，任何人不得怠慢。所有官吏瞬间收敛神色，不敢再有半分戏谑，纷纷躬身垂首，肃立接旨。
仙官目光扫过全场，最终落于神色紧绷的巡抚使罗德身上，朗声宣读法旨。一字一句，铿锵有力，响彻云海，落进每个人耳中。
“天帝有命，凌霄巡抚使罗德见法旨后，随少主帝昊一同返回天帝城述职，不得有误！”
啊，这……
罗德浑身一僵，瞳孔骤然收缩，脸上所有的淡漠与从容瞬间碎裂殆尽，整个人愣在原地。这实在太突然，之前他从未接到过通知，而且少主交接的时候，更是提都没提。他错愕地看向少主，发现后者同样满面茫然，明显事先对这命令毫不知情。
“大人……”罗德看向高处盛气凌人的仙官，终究没有把心里的话说出来，只能恭恭敬敬地跪下。
“下臣接旨！”
……
鎏金仙舟破空启程，撕裂层层云海。
此舟乃是天家专用，辅以九天灵纹加持，速度绝伦。方才还能清晰望见的凌霄城城楼轮廓，转瞬之间便被远远甩在身后，化作地平线上一抹模糊的黑影。紧接着罡风呼啸，流云倒卷，万顷云涛在船身两侧飞速向后掠去，快得只剩一片片纯白残影。
陆长风粗略地估了估，自己就算御剑也没这玩意快，得御风才能追上它。难得的是，这玩意快归快，却能稳稳地穿梭于九霄之上，没有任何颠簸的感觉，唯有耳畔不息的风声，印证着它极致的行速。

船首位置，罗德独立临风。一身墨色官袍被高空罡风吹得猎猎作响，衣袂翻飞不止。他自始至终沉默伫立，背脊挺直，目光遥遥望向无尽云海，一语不发，周身萦绕着一层生人勿近的沉寂气场，看不出喜怒，却满身都是心绪不宁的滞涩。
说起来他也是悲催，好不容易把少主送走，结果天帝一纸命令，他就得回去。这就好比一个丫鬟好不容易等到小姐出嫁能继承她家产了，结果老爷大手一挥，你也陪小姐嫁过去吧……
此时陆长风正好立于船身中段的廊柱旁，远远看着罗德孤寂的背影，心底暗自觉得好笑。想凌霄城一众官吏世家权贵忙前忙后在巡抚府倒洗脚水，一个个胸脯拍得震天响，结果天帝一道法旨落下，众人全白忙活了。
反倒是他陆长风天天睡到日上三竿起来，却能跟随少主前往天帝城，真是讽刺！所以说，这个人呐，太聪明太能钻营不见得有用，有时候不认命都不行。
“张强。”
就在陆长风心中暗自感慨之际，少主温和清淡声音自身后响起。
陆长风扭头看去，只见少主缓步走来，素白长袍随步伐轻垂，褪去了送别时的些许倦怠，神色平和淡然。
“少主……”
看着少主那盛世美颜，陆长风不禁暗自惭愧。这个人呐，怎么能这么帅呢！自己哪怕有他一半的魅力，也能少走很多弯路。
少主望向窗外翻涌的云海，轻声开口打破沉寂：“用不了多久就到仙界了，你可有什么往后的打算？”
陆长风闻言收回思绪，带着一贯的耿直憨厚，如实回道：“少主，这个属下还真没仔细想过。不过呢，属下既然跟着少主出来了，如果少主不嫌弃，那便照旧给少主当护卫便是，这样就不用费心琢磨新门道。再说了，少主对属下恩重如山，能继续守在少主身边，属下便知足了。”
这番话虽然水平不咋地，但也见赤诚。
少主并未立刻接话，只是沉静地望着远方云海，微风拂过他额前的碎发，让他看起来更加气质斐然。沉默片刻后，他才缓缓开口，语气带着几分认真与期许：“其实，你不必一直拘在我身侧，困于护卫一职。若是你不嫌弃，我可以为你举荐，入仙界两大顶尖修行道统，天元剑宗，或是天机阁。”
哇，这……
虽然早就了解过这两大宗门，陆长风还是内心一阵躁动，没想到少主居然为他举荐这两个地方。他装作什么也不知道的样子，问道：“少主，这两家是干什么的？”
“两宗皆是仙界底蕴深厚的顶级宗门，各有千秋。剑宗专修剑道杀伐，锋芒盖世；天机阁推演乾坤、洞悉天道，奥妙无穷。你可自行挑选一处拜师修行，精进大道。”
少主的回应略显奇怪，不过陆长风也没多想，只当对方是觉得继续让自己当护卫委屈了自己。他随即咧嘴一笑，憨声憨气地回道：“那可真是太好了，多谢少主。不过属下就是个粗人，没读过多少书，什么天机不天机，我也不懂，不如就选天元剑宗吧。抡剑杀敌，简单直接，我也学得顺手。”
“好，就依你！”
少主唇角扬起一抹温润的笑意，让人如沐春风。
content_en:
Chapter 1180 Heading to the Immortal Realm
After the words fell, the air became silent for a moment.
The look of envy on Yuan Liangmei's face instantly froze, her cheek muscles twitched violently several times, and her entire face suddenly turned green and extremely ugly. He has always liked to climb high branches to save his face, but now he is so bluntly "thought about" by Lu Changfeng. Hearing these seemingly sincere but actually sarcastic words, he just feels awkward all over and can't keep his old face.
Seeing this, all the officials and families around them suppressed their laughter, and their shoulders trembled slightly. We are all in the same circle, and everyone knows that each other wants to go to the fairy world. Lu Changfeng's greeting now sounds too humiliating. But his tone was sincere and he looked like he was sincerely saying goodbye. Yuan Liangmei couldn't find anything wrong with him and could only swallow the sullen breath. Right, a domestic slave has become close to the young master, you, the master, are just acting like a fool, you are really stupid...
"Goodbye everyone!"
Even though he was unwilling to do so, the young master still maintained his demeanor, bowed his hands slightly to everyone, and was about to leave.
But at this moment, a mighty and majestic fairy sound suddenly fell from the clouds in the sky, shaking the entire Yungang.
"The decree of the Emperor of Heaven has arrived!"
Everyone looked up after hearing the sound, and saw a gap in the clouds. An immortal official wearing a purple gold and black robe and an immortal crown came stepping on the clouds. He had an elegant posture and a serious bearing. He held a gilded edict in his hand and walked steadily to the center of the high platform.
The decree of the Emperor of Heaven is the supreme existence and no one can neglect it. All the officials immediately calmed down and did not dare to joke any more. They bowed their heads and stood solemnly to receive the order.
The Immortal Official's gaze swept across the entire venue, finally landing on the tense-looking Governor Rhodes, and read out the decree loudly. Every word is sonorous and powerful, resounding through the sea of ​​clouds and falling into everyone's ears.
"The Emperor of Heaven has an order. Governor Lingxiao's envoy Rhodes will return to the Emperor's City with his young master Di Hao to report on his duties after seeing the decree. There must be no mistakes!"
Ah, this...
Rhodes froze, his pupils suddenly shrank, all the indifference and calmness on his face instantly shattered, and he froze in place. This was so sudden. He had never been notified before, and the young master didn't even mention it when he handed over. He looked at the young master in astonishment and found that the latter was also at a loss, and it was obvious that he had no prior knowledge of this order.
"Sir..." Rhodes looked at the domineering immortal official from above. After all, he did not say what was in his heart and could only kneel down respectfully.
"I accept the order!"
…
The gilded fairy boat set off through the sky, tearing apart the sea of clouds.
This boat is exclusively used by the Tian family, and is blessed by the Nine Heavens Spirit Pattern, making it extremely fast. The outline of Lingxiao City's towers that could only be clearly seen a moment ago was left far behind in an instant, turning into a blurry black shadow on the horizon. Immediately afterwards, the strong wind howled, the flowing clouds rolled back, and the vast expanse of cloud waves swept back quickly on both sides of the ship, so fast that only pure white afterimages were left.
Lu Changfeng made a rough estimate and found that he was not as fast as this thing even if he was wielding a sword. He would have to use the wind to catch up with it. What's rare is that this thing can return quickly, but it can shuttle steadily through the sky without any bumps. Only the constant sound of wind in the ears confirms its extreme speed.
In the bow position, Rhodes faces the wind independently. A dark official robe was blown by the high-altitude wind, and his sleeves kept flying. He stood silently from beginning to end, with his back straight and his eyes looking far into the endless sea of ​​clouds without saying a word. There was a layer of silent aura around him that kept strangers away from him. He could not see any joy or anger, but his whole body was full of restless stagnation.
Speaking of which, he was also miserable. He finally sent the young master away, but with the emperor's order, he had to go back. This is like a maid who waited hard for the young lady to get married and inherit her family property, but the master waved his hand and asked you to marry the young lady too...
At this time, Lu Changfeng was standing by the pillar in the middle of the ship, looking at Rhodes' lonely back from a distance, feeling secretly amused in his heart. I think all the officials and dignitaries in Lingxiao City are busy here and there.The governor's mansion poured water to wash their feet, and everyone clapped their chests loudly. As a result, the Emperor of Heaven issued a decree, and everyone's work was in vain.
On the contrary, Lu Changfeng, who sleeps until midnight every day, can follow the young master to Tiandi City. How ironic! Therefore, this person may not be useful if he is too smart or too capable of maneuvering, and sometimes even if he refuses to accept his fate, it won't work.
"Zhang Qiang."
Just as Lu Changfeng was sighing secretly in his heart, the young master's gentle and calm voice sounded behind him.
Lu Changfeng turned around and saw the young master walking slowly, his plain white robe hanging lightly with his steps. He had lost some of the fatigue from the farewell, and his expression was calm and indifferent.
"Young Master..."
Looking at the young master's magnificent beauty, Lu Changfeng couldn't help but feel ashamed secretly. How can this man be so handsome! Even if I were half as charming as him, I would still be able to avoid many detours.
The young master looked out the window at the billowing sea of clouds and spoke softly to break the silence: "It won't be long before we reach the fairyland. What are your plans for the future?"
After hearing this, Lu Changfeng withdrew his thoughts and replied truthfully with his usual honest and honest attitude: "Young Master, this subordinate really hasn't thought about it carefully. However, since the subordinate has followed the young master out, if the young master doesn't dislike it, then he can continue to be the young master's bodyguard, so that he doesn't have to worry about new ways. Besides, the young master is very kind to his subordinate, and he will be satisfied if he can continue to stay by his side."
Although these words were not very good, they were sincere.
The young master did not answer immediately, but looked calmly at the sea of ​​clouds in the distance. The breeze blew through the broken hair on his forehead, making him look even more elegant. After a moment of silence, he spoke slowly, with a tone of seriousness and expectation: "Actually, you don't have to stay by my side and be trapped in the position of guard. If you don't mind, I can recommend you to join the two top cultivation traditions in the immortal world, Tianyuan Sword Sect or Tianji Pavilion."
Wow, this...
Although he had known about these two major sects for a long time, Lu Changfeng still felt restless in his heart. He did not expect that the young master actually recommended these two places to him. He pretended to know nothing and asked, "Young Master, what do these two families do?"
"Both sects are top sects with profound foundations in the immortal world, and each has its own merits. The Sword Sect specializes in killing with the sword, and is unrivaled in the world; the Tianji Pavilion deduce the universe, and understands the way of heaven, with endless mysteries. You can choose a place to become a disciple and practice, and advance to the great path."
The young master's response was a little strange, but Lu Changfeng didn't think much about it and just assumed that the other party felt that he had been wronged by continuing to serve as a guard. He immediately grinned and replied in a naive voice: "That's great, thank you young master. But my subordinate is just a rough guy. I haven't read many books, and I don't understand what secrets are. Why not choose the Tianyuan Sword Sect. Killing enemies with a sword is simple and straightforward, and I can learn it easily."
"Okay, it's up to you!"
A warm smile appeared on the young master's lips, which made people feel like a spring breeze.
